topic: Ada air di dalam iPhone 17 Pro, dan itu sengaja (ruang uap)

assets.units: macro set, about 3.6 x 1.6 units; scale exaggerated; hot end at -X, cool end at +X

cycle.affects: droplets creep 0.4 toward the hot end, vapour drifts 0.4 toward the cool end; loops seamlessly

heat.affects: glow of the chip under the chamber

cool_glow.affects: glow of the body plate at the cool end

assets.notes: Conceptual illustration of a generic vapor chamber. Apple states only that deionized water is sealed in a chamber laser-welded to the aluminium body.
